header.name: Concurrent and Learned Data Structures
header.description: This course aims to introduce the concurrent and learned data structures to senior undergraduate, master's and Ph.D. students who have familiarity with data structures. The course will interleavingly cover both the concepts. The concurrent data structures teaching will consist of the concepts of consistency, progress guarantees, and amortized step compexity. We will delve in to the design and implementation of concurrent lock-based and lock-free linked-lists, binary search trees, hash tables, skip-lists and queries such as range search. The learned data structures teaching will first introduce the concept of learned query. We will then cover the learned index structures such as recursive model index and its variants and learned bloom filters. Finally, some very recent developments on relaxed and persistent concurrent data structures will be discussed.
prerequisites_mandatory: Programming Skills in C++/Java and Python
prerequisites_desirable: Having familiarity with C++/Java multithreading and basic machine learning models/algorithm will definitely help. However, these topics will be covered in the course.
prerequisites_mandatory_resolved: Programming Skills in C++/Java and Python
prerequisites_desirable_resolved: Having familiarity with C++/Java multithreading and basic machine learning models/algorithm will definitely help. However, these topics will be covered in the course.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: To develop insights into the concepts of concurrency, synchronization, safety and progress properties of concurrent objects.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: To deconstruct and analyse existing concurrent data structures and their extensions such as relaxed and persistent concurrent data structures.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: To develop insights into the concept of learned queries over big data utilizing machine learning inference, thereby deconstruct and critique learned data structures.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: To plan, design, implement and analyse potentially new concurrent and learned data structures.

lecture_topics: Introduction to concurrency and shared memory system
Adaptive Single Layer Model and Adaptive Learned index
Lock-free Range and Nearest Neighbour Queries
Learned Multidimensional Index and Learned Bloom Filters

assessments.type_label: Assignment (Report on an existing sequential data structure with queries)
